modInfo: 而这场灾难爆发的时候，这家工厂还在运作中，数百人没有来得及撤离，感染蔓延到了每一个角落，在最后一声惨叫被淹没在吞咽声和咀嚼声之后，
这里只剩下了一片寂静.......这里或许是一个建立安全屋的好地方，但你得花大力气才能清理这里的危险并确保周围的安全，万事小心。
[A mechanical processing factory located in the suburbs of West Point, adjacent to the riverbank and facing a large lake,
with a floor area of 500 * 500 square meters.
The large production workshop on the first floor and the administrative office area on the second floor once accommodated hundreds of
people working here at the same time. When the disaster broke out, the factory was still in operation, and hundreds of people did not have time to evacuate.
The infection spread to every corner. After the last scream was drowned out by swallowing and chewing sounds, there was only silence left here.
This may be a good place to build a safe house, but you have to put in a lot of effort to clear the dangers here and ensure the safety of the surroundings.
